correctness.rationale: Sylvester determinant reduction on the hypersimplex x1+x2+x3=2 yields D=1+2(b+k)+B e2+H e3, with b=gamma(1-a)-1, k=gamma a, B=b(b+2k), H=b^2(b+3k). On the newly found lower interval B,H>=0, e2 and e3 are concave on the feasible slice, so log D is concave. The two PSD spectral scale regimes cover the other sufficient intervals. Throughout the excluded middle B<0, a strictly interior point x=(delta,1-delta/2,1-delta/2) has positive second logdet derivative along (0,1,-1), so the endpoints are necessary. Symmetry gives the center optimum and strict scale monotonicity. Strong negative slice-Hessian margin implies small non-equicorrelated perturbation stability. Independent symbolic determinant and rational sign checks confirm key algebra, not arbitrary-parameter theorem.
